symptom: The natural daily readiness run reached the research payload but exited before producing readiness evidence because the required current-scope feature day index was absent.
lesson: A Daily Readiness red run can be a fail-closed dependency absence rather than a cache or runner failure. Confirm the required derived day index exists before treating the readiness builder itself as defective.
guardrail: Do not rerun protected Daily Readiness while the required current-scope day index is absent. Inspect the upstream natural feature-rollup result and only retry after the day-index dependency or its producing material state has changed.
